_comment: Known totals and priority for coverage tracking. This file is the canonical copy; build_from_db.py reads it to compute docs/data.json meta.coverage (indexed counts come from hub.db). source_check.py reads sample_url and discovery_check for accessibility probes. Update known_total when you learn a source's real size; null when unknown.

What Works Clearinghouse.notes: 619 intervention reports + 30 practice guides = 649. 375 indexed. Config: sources/wwc.json.

Digital Promise.notes: DSpace REST API. 273 items on the server (2026-08-28); 259 indexed + 2 backlog. Config: sources/digital-promise.json (date-sorted so early_stop is safe).

UChicago Consortium on School Research.notes: 319 publications. 320 indexed after the 2026-08-30 backfill (31 from the May 2026 hand pass); 3 pending rows without a page abstract. Config: sources/uchicago-consortium.json (detail_fetch for og:description abstracts). In the weekly source list.

Evidence for ESSA.notes: WP REST API. 1,297 programs (202 rated: 84 Strong, 36 Moderate, 82 Promising). 221 indexed. Config: sources/evidence-for-essa.json.

NWEA Research.notes: 200+ publications confirmed (paginated). MAP Growth longitudinal research.

Mathematica.notes: Coveo API (no auth needed). ~925 unique education pubs after dedup. 474 indexed. Config: sources/mathematica.json.

WestEd.notes: Regional lab. ~1,254 library items; 912 indexed after the 2026-08-30 backfill (898 inserted; 364 practitioner-resource items kept as excluded type_filtered rows); weekly runs continue from here. Config: sources/wested.json.

TNTP.notes: 36 publications confirmed (4 JS-rendered pages). WebFetch only sees page 1. Teacher effectiveness research.

Journal of Educational Data Mining.notes: Selective methods-paper set (39 entries), reinstated 2026-08-28. Not scraped systematically; excluded from the weekly run.

Journal of Learning Analytics.notes: Selective methods-paper set (39 entries), reinstated 2026-08-28. Not scraped systematically; excluded from the weekly run.

Campbell Collaboration.notes: 52 education systematic reviews total on one page.

Learning Policy Institute.notes: ~347 research pubs (167 reports, 139 briefs, 41 fact sheets). 165 indexed (reports only). Briefs/fact sheets need separate configs. Config: sources/lpi.json.

The Education Trust.notes: 582 RTI URLs in the sitemap, 402 in the REST API. 362 indexed after the 2026-08-30 backfill (331 inserted; 14 pending without a description; 26 State News/Campaign/Press Releases kept as excluded type_filtered rows).

IES Regional Education Labs.notes: 10 regional pages. Listing is JS-rendered; index individual publications by ID.

Brookings Institution.notes: Curate manually — only Brown Center on Education Policy articles qualify.

CREDO at Stanford.notes: Charter-studies page lists 9 reports; 16 indexed (earlier report-finder pass added 7). Total unknown until the finder is scraped. Config: sources/credo.json.

AIMS Collaboratory.notes: Near-complete. Slow publication cadence; check manually a few times a year.

National Academies of Sciences, Engineer.notes: 2 indexed (How People Learn I & II). 3-6 more landmark education reports identified.

Collaborative for Academic, Social, and.notes: 1 entry (SEL Framework). Essentially complete for current scope.
